baseline.release_status: Published; 62 downloaded public assets and 227 tagged runtime sources independently verified, both CI workflows passed, exact published Linux package exercised for title/world entry, keyboard drill entry, F5 normal reset and title return. Broader local checks remain separate; Windows execution and physical-GPU profiling remain open.

historical_traversal_release.scope: Historical traversal/army preview: 46 public assets verified and bounded exact-Linux window repeat passed; archives retain their original names.

baseline.public_package_identity_limit: Local/public inventories share 227 runtime sources and 226 resource paths; 217 packed resources match and 9 imported/generated SCNs differ. Bounded public execution does not assert binary or full visual equivalence.

release_evidence.scope: All 62 actual public downloads, exact tag/inventories, tagged source identity and both platform archive/resource checks.

evidence_policy: Complete requires existing source-pinned evidence covering every acceptance condition. An import/test/staticimage proves only its named scope. Milestones close only after prerequisites and all own tasks pass.
